newsitem.title: INDONESIA: ASEAN to keep 10-nation flag despite Cambodia.
newsitem.headline: ASEAN to keep 10-nation flag despite Cambodia.

text.p: The Association of South East Asian Nations (ASEAN) is to keep its new 10-nation flag and logo despite putting Cambodia's membership on hold, ASEAN Secretary-General Ajit Singh said on Friday.

Asked if Cambodia's postponed membership would affect the flag, he said: "It will still be the 10 stalks of paddy, and the reason we have maintained it is because this is the vision of all the ASEAN 10."
Cambodia was due to join ASEAN with Burma and Laos next week, expanding ASEAN's membership to 10 nations.

But ASEAN foreign ministers last week decided to postpone admitting Cambodia since Second Prime Minister Hun Sen overthrew First Prime Minister Prince Norodom Ranariddh in a violent coup in the capital on July 5-6.
ASEAN currently groups Brunei, Indonesia, Malaysia, the Philippines, Singapore, Thailand and Vietnam.
The new flag unveiled late in May comprises a blue background with a centred red circle enclosing 10 yellow stalks of rice paddy. A thin white ring encircles the red ring.

"The 10 stalks of paddy represent the dream of ASEAN's founding fathers for an ASEAN comprising all the 10 countries in southeast Asia bound together in friendship and solidarity," the organisation said.
